authenticity_review: The image demonstrates strong photorealism in lighting, texture rendering, and depth-of-field composition. However, structural integrity issues persist: (1) Paw/ground fusion is visible in the front-row dogs where toes blend into leaves/dirt rather than resting distinctly upon them; (2) Subtle boundary bleeding occurs between adjacent dogs in the back row, particularly around shoulder/chest regions; (3) The animal_pose_auditor reported MEDIUM artifact risk (35% low-confidence keypoints), concentrated in hind limbs and faces, which aligns with visual observations of anatomical ambiguity in these areas. These defects prevent a higher authenticity score despite otherwise excellent rendering quality.
